name: g2_giants_isi
label: ISI at Palomar with MPD PDM 100 um SPADs: red giants, supergiants and red-clump stars, 650 and 900 nm, a baseline per night from 3 m to 1 km
notes: Each schedule entry is one night per backend on the ISI pair at that East-West baseline: the trucks move between nights. The runner reports every configuration and the combined Fisher precision on the diameter and on the linear limb-darkening coefficient.

The PDM's 77 ns dead time with a 4e6 cps operating cap: every giant brighter than ~R 2 is attenuated to the same rate, so they share the same S/N per night; the cap is 16x the ID230's and the timing 3x better, which is what brings the sidelobes (and so the limb darkening) within reach.
First nulls at 900 / 650 nm: Betelgeuse 5.4 / 3.9 m, Aldebaran 11.0 / 8.0, Arcturus 10.8 / 7.8, mu Cep 16.2 / 11.7, eps Tau 84 / 61, HD 360 250 / 180 m; the trucks cannot park closer than 2.5 m.
